seerr.title.description: Settings > Integrations > Requests page. Row label on the Settings root and page title. Also the title of the Requests area.

seerr.root_detail.description: Settings > Integrations > Requests page. Detail line under the Requests row on the Settings root. One short sentence.

seerr.copy.value: Requests lets you ask for movies and shows that are not in the library yet. It uses Seerr. Turn it on and check the address.
seerr.copy.description: Settings > Integrations > Requests page. Narrative copy beside the page. Seerr is a product name; keep it.

seerr.enabled.description: Settings > Integrations > Requests page. Switch row label: turns the Requests area on.

seerr.enabled_detail.value: Adds Requests to the top bar
seerr.enabled_detail.description: Settings > Integrations > Requests page. Line under the switch row.

seerr.address.description: Settings > Integrations > Requests page. Row label: where Seerr runs (its web address).

seerr.address_detail.description: Settings > Integrations > Requests page. Line under the Address row: how the address starts. Keep https:// and http:// as they are.

seerr.test.description: Settings > Integrations > Requests page. Action row: ask Seerr whether the address works and sign in.

seerr.forget.description: Settings > Integrations > Requests page. Action row: remove the stored address and sign-in.

seerr.forget_detail.value: Removes the address and the sign-in
seerr.forget_detail.description: Settings > Integrations > Requests page. Line under the Forget row.

seerr.forget_sure.description: Settings > Integrations > Requests page. Value on the Forget row after the first OK: press again to confirm.

seerr.not_set.description: Settings > Integrations > Requests page. Address row value when no address is stored.

seerr.summary_off.description: Settings root. Value of the Requests row while Requests is off.

seerr.problem_scheme.value: The address must start with https:// or http://.
seerr.problem_scheme.description: Settings > Integrations > Requests page. Status when the typed address has no https:// or http://.

seerr.problem_plaintext.value: Plain http:// is only for addresses on your home network. Use https:// for any other.
seerr.problem_plaintext.description: Settings > Integrations > Requests page. Status when http:// is typed for an address that is not on the home network.

seerr.problem_host.value: That is not a valid address.
seerr.problem_host.description: Settings > Integrations > Requests page. Status when the typed address cannot be used.

seerr.status_off.value: Requests is off. Turn it on to see Requests in the top bar.
seerr.status_off.description: Settings > Integrations > Requests page. Status line while the switch is off.

seerr.status_unset.value: Not set up. Add the address of your Seerr, then test.
seerr.status_unset.description: Settings > Integrations > Requests page. Status line while no address is stored.

seerr.status_untested.value: Not tested yet. Choose Test connection to check the address.
seerr.status_untested.description: Settings > Integrations > Requests page. Status line when an address is stored but not tried.

seerr.status_testing.description: Settings > Integrations > Requests page. Status line while the test runs.

seerr.status_connected.description: Settings > Integrations > Requests page. Status line after a good test. {version} is Seerr's version number, {name} the viewer's name.

seerr.status_unreachable.value: Can't reach Seerr. No answer from that address. Check it and that this TV is on the same network.
seerr.status_unreachable.description: Settings > Integrations > Requests page, and the Requests area. Seerr did not answer.

seerr.status_not_seerr.value: That is not Seerr. The address answers, but not like Seerr. Check the address.
seerr.status_not_seerr.description: Settings > Integrations > Requests page, and the Requests area. The address answered but is not Seerr.

seerr.status_no_plex.value: Seerr needs the Plex account that is signed in on this TV. Sign in to Plex first.
seerr.status_no_plex.description: Settings > Integrations > Requests page, and the Requests area. No Plex account is signed in.

seerr.status_refused.value: Seerr refused the sign-in. This Plex account may not have access to Seerr.
seerr.status_refused.description: Settings > Integrations > Requests page, and the Requests area. Seerr did not accept the Plex sign-in.

seerr.status_rate.value: Seerr says too many tries. Wait a minute and try again.
seerr.status_rate.description: Settings > Integrations > Requests page, and the Requests area. Seerr is limiting the number of sign-ins.

seerr.status_forbidden.value: Seerr does not let this account ask for titles.
seerr.status_forbidden.description: Settings > Integrations > Requests page, and the Requests area. The account has no permission to request.

seerr.status_already.description: The Requests area. A request for this title is already in.

seerr.status_failed.value: Seerr could not do that. Try again later.
seerr.status_failed.description: The Requests area. Seerr answered with an error.

requests.title.description: Requests area. Page title and the crumb above a title's page.

requests.tab.description: Requests area. Label of the top bar pill. One word.

requests.placeholder.description: Requests area. Label of the search pill in the page header; the same word as the top bar's Search.

requests.mine.description: Requests area. Row heading: the titles the viewer asked for.

requests.trending.description: Requests area. Row heading: titles many people watch now.

requests.upcoming.description: Requests area. Row heading: movies not out yet.

requests.results.description: Requests area. Row heading over search results.

requests.loading.description: Requests area. Shown while the first rows load.

requests.searching.description: Requests area. Shown while a search runs.

requests.empty.description: Requests area. Shown when no row has any title.

requests.failed.description: Requests area. Heading shown when Seerr did not answer; the reason follows below it.

requests.no_results.description: Requests area. Shown when a search found nothing. {query} is what was typed.

requests.badge_requested.description: Requests area. Badge on a poster: asked for, waiting for approval. One short word.

requests.badge_approved.description: Requests area. Badge on a poster: approved, not downloading yet.

requests.badge_downloading.description: Requests area. Badge on a poster: on its way.

requests.badge_partly.description: Requests area. Badge on a poster: some of a series is in the library.

requests.badge_available.description: Requests area. Badge on a poster: in the library.

requests.badge_blocked.description: Requests area. Badge on a poster: Seerr does not allow requests for it.

requests.badge_declined.description: Requests area. Badge on a poster: the request was turned down.

requests.badge_failed.description: Requests area. Badge on a poster: the request could not be completed.

requests.play.description: Requests area, a title's page. Action row: play the title from the Plex library.

requests.play_detail.description: Requests area, a title's page. Line under Play.

requests.request.description: Requests area, a title's page. Action row: ask Seerr for the title.

requests.already.description: Requests area, a title's page. Shown instead of Request when Seerr already has a request for the title.

requests.available.description: Requests area, a title's page. Shown instead of Request when the title is already in the library.

requests.unavailable.description: Requests area, a title's page. Shown instead of Request when Seerr does not allow it.

requests.not_yet.description: Requests area, a title's page. Shown instead of Request when the title has not been released.

requests.seasons.description: Requests area, a title's page. Section heading over the season choices of a series.

requests.season.description: Requests area, a title's page. Row label for one season. {number} is the season number.

requests.specials.description: Requests area, a title's page. Row label for the extra episodes of a series (season zero).

requests.sending.description: Requests area, a title's page. Status line while the request is on its way.

requests.sent.value: Requested. It will show up here when it is ready.
requests.sent.description: Requests area, a title's page. Status line after a request went through.
